defmodule NetProxy.Config do
  @moduledoc "Environment-dependent configuration for network proxy"

  def proxy_port, do: System.get_env("PROXY_PORT", "8080") |> String.to_integer()
  def upstream_host, do: System.get_env("UPSTREAM_HOST", "localhost")
  def upstream_port, do: System.get_env("UPSTREAM_PORT", "9090") |> String.to_integer()
  def temp_dir, do: System.get_env("PROXY_TEMP_DIR", "/tmp/net_proxy_private")
  def session_prefix, do: System.get_env("SESSION_PREFIX", "proxy_session")
end

defmodule NetProxy.SessionStore do
  @moduledoc "Manages session state files for proxy connections"

  alias NetProxy.Config

  def init_session(conn_id, metadata) do
    path = session_path(conn_id)
    ensure_dir(path)
    write_session(path, metadata)
    {:ok, path}
  end

  def read_session(conn_id) do
    path = session_path(conn_id)
    case File.read(path) do
      {:ok, content} -> {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(content, [:safe])}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  def cleanup_session(conn_id) do
    path = session_path(conn_id)
    File.rm(path)
  end

  defp session_path(conn_id) do
    base = Config.temp_dir()
    prefix = Config.session_prefix()
    # Generate deterministic path from connection ID
    hash = :crypto.hash(:sha256, conn_id) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    token = String.slice(hash, 0, 12)
    Path.join(base, "#{prefix}_#{token}")
  end

  defp ensure_dir(path) do
    dir = Path.dirname(path)
    File.mkdir_p(dir)
    File.chmod(dir, 0o700)
  end

  defp write_session(path, metadata) do
    content = :erlang.term_to_binary(metadata)
    # Write with exclusive flag and restrictive permissions
    case :file.open(String.to_charlist(path), [:write, :exclusive, :binary]) do
      {:ok, fd} ->
        :file.write(fd, content)
        :file.close(fd)
        File.chmod(path, 0o600)
      {:error, :eexist} ->
        # File already exists - regenerate with randomness
        new_path = path <> "_" <> (:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower))
        File.write(new_path, content)
        File.chmod(new_path, 0o600)
    end
  end
end

defmodule NetProxy.TempBuffer do
  @moduledoc "Temporary buffer files for large proxy payloads"

  alias NetProxy.Config

  @threshold 65_536

  def buffer_payload(conn_id, payload) when byte_size(payload) > @threshold do
    path = buffer_path(conn_id)
    case write_exclusive(path, payload) do
      :ok -> {:buffered, path}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  def buffer_payload(_conn_id, payload) do
    {:inline, payload}
  end

  def read_buffer(path) do
    File.read(path)
  end

  def release_buffer(path) do
    File.rm(path)
  end

  defp buffer_path(_conn_id) do
    base = Config.temp_dir()
    # Use cryptographically random name to prevent prediction
    random_part = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    Path.join(base, "proxy_buf_#{random_part}")
  end

  defp write_exclusive(path, content) do
    case :file.open(String.to_charlist(path), [:write, :exclusive, :binary]) do
      {:ok, fd} ->
        :file.write(fd, content)
        :file.close(fd)
        File.chmod(path, 0o600)
        :ok
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end
end

defmodule NetProxy.ConnectionHandler do
  @moduledoc "Handles individual proxy connections"

  alias NetProxy.{Config, SessionStore, TempBuffer}

  def handle_connection(client_socket) do
    conn_id = generate_conn_id()
    metadata = %{
      started_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      client_addr: peer_address(client_socket),
      upstream: {Config.upstream_host(), Config.upstream_port()}
    }

    {:ok, _session_path} = SessionStore.init_session(conn_id, metadata)

    case proxy_data(client_socket, conn_id) do
      :ok -> SessionStore.cleanup_session(conn_id)
      {:error, _reason} -> SessionStore.cleanup_session(conn_id)
    end
  end

  defp proxy_data(client_socket, conn_id) do
    case :gen_tcp.recv(client_socket, 0, 30_000) do
      {:ok, data} ->
        case TempBuffer.buffer_payload(conn_id, data) do
          {:buffered, path} ->
            forward_from_file(path, conn_id)
            TempBuffer.release_buffer(path)
          {:inline, payload} ->
            forward_payload(payload, conn_id)
        end
        proxy_data(client_socket, conn_id)
      {:error, :closed} -> :ok
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp forward_from_file(path, _conn_id) do
    {:ok, data} = TempBuffer.read_buffer(path)
    forward_payload(data, _conn_id)
  end

  defp forward_payload(_payload, _conn_id) do
    # Forward to upstream - implementation omitted for brevity
    :ok
  end

  defp generate_conn_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp peer_address(socket) do
    case :inet.peername(socket) do
      {:ok, {addr, port}} -> "#{:inet.ntoa(addr)}:#{port}"
      _ -> "unknown"
    end
  end
end

defmodule NetProxy.Server do
  @moduledoc "Main TCP proxy server"

  alias NetProxy.{Config, ConnectionHandler}

  def start do
    port = Config.proxy_port()
    # Ensure private temp directory exists with correct permissions
    temp = Config.temp_dir()
    File.mkdir_p(temp)
    File.chmod(temp, 0o700)
    opts = [:binary, packet: :raw, active: false, reuseaddr: true]
    {:ok, listen_socket} = :gen_tcp.listen(port, opts)
    accept_loop(listen_socket)
  end

  defp accept_loop(listen_socket) do
    {:ok, client_socket} = :gen_tcp.accept(listen_socket)
    Task.start(fn -> ConnectionHandler.handle_connection(client_socket) end)
    accept_loop(listen_socket)
  end
end
